probe: SELECT d.field_name, d.field_value FROM tax_data d JOIN tax_returns tr ON tr.id = d.return_id WHERE tr.user_email = :email AND tr.tax_year = 2025 AND d.field_name IN ('charitable_contributions','charitable_total')

extra_probes.sql: SELECT ifnull(sum(t.amount),0) AS don FROM transactions t JOIN accounts a ON a.id = t.account_id WHERE a.user_email = :email AND strftime('%Y', t.date)='2025' AND (lower(t.description) LIKE '%donat%' OR lower(t.description) LIKE '%charit%' OR lower(ifnull(t.category,'')) LIKE '%charit%')
